title: RedditScope
tagline: Web3 platform for accessing and monetizing Reddit-driven market data
description:
This project is a Web3-focused data intelligence platform that monitors Reddit discussions to capture authentic, community-driven sentiment around blockchain networks. Instead of relying on surface-level metrics or hype, it tracks what real users are saying — whether they support, criticize, or express concerns about specific chains.

The goal is to provide transparent, user-generated insights into how communities perceive different blockchains. By analyzing honest conversations, debates, and feedback, the platform transforms raw Reddit chatter into structured market data. This data can then be accessed, sold, or integrated into decentralized applications through Web3 rails, creating a marketplace for unbiased, community-driven insights.

In short, it’s a way to understand the “true voice of the community” on blockchain ecosystems — what chains people genuinely like or dislike, and why.
how_its_made:
How It’s Made
The platform continuously monitors Reddit for discussions about blockchain networks and converts them into structured, actionable market data using advanced AI from the Artificial Superintelligence Alliance (ASA).

Data Collection:
We use Reddit’s API and custom crawlers to track posts and comments across relevant subreddits. This ensures we capture both high-level trends and detailed community conversations about different chains.

Data Processing & Analysis:
Instead of traditional NLP, we leverage ASA’s AI models to interpret and analyze user discussions. The AI identifies sentiment, extracts meaningful insights, and organizes topics based on real community opinions. This allows us to detect genuine user sentiment — whether positive, negative, or neutral — and summarize discussions effectively.

Storage & Web3 Integration:
Processed data is stored in a decentralized-compatible format, enabling secure access and potential monetization through Web3 protocols. Smart contracts manage permissions and data access for users who wish to use the insights.

Hacky / Notable Aspects:
To overcome Reddit API rate limits while keeping data real-time, we combined scheduled API calls with selective web scraping. This hybrid approach ensures no important conversation is missed.

Technologies Used:

ASA (Artificial Superintelligence Alliance) for sentiment and insight analysis

Python for backend logic and integration

PostgreSQL / decentralized storage for storing structured data

Web3 protocols / smart contracts for secure access and monetization

Reddit API & custom crawlers for comprehensive data collection

This setup allows us to deliver Web3-ready datasets that reflect authentic, community-driven opinions on blockchain networks.
